purpose: Stage B broker deployment contract; not an apply manifest

preDeploymentInventoryOperation.name: production-predeployment-rotation-inventory
preDeploymentInventoryOperation.execution: one bounded Fargate task through this broker only
preDeploymentInventoryOperation.resultChannel: exact task awslogs stream, one structured aggregate JSON record
preDeploymentInventoryOperation.cleanupBudgetSemantics: cleanup consumes only the remaining request budget, capped at 30 seconds; it does not extend the 130-second total

replayStore.preDeploymentLogicalKey: SHA256(canonical JSON of approvalId, releaseSha, rotationId, operation, and imageDigest); taskDefinitionArn is retained in the row and key collisions fail closed
replayStore.launchFailureRecovery: known pre-launch failures release the claim; any launch-attempt uncertainty remains claimed with task identity for reviewed reconciliation

resourcePolicy.representation: design contract, not an AddPermission payload
resourcePolicy.nextDeploymentPackage: aws_lambda_permission with function_name, qualifier=reviewed, action=lambda:InvokeFunction, and principal=mscqr-production-release-deployer
